hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of people are those who are best to their families.'
hadith_entries.lesson: Being kind to family is beautiful

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.'
The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young ones.'
hadith_entries.lesson: Being kind to little children is part of Islam

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Respect your parents, and Allah will make things easy for you.'
hadith_entries.source_reference: Simplified from multiple authentic sources (scholarly review recommended for direct citation)
hadith_entries.primary_source: Simplified from multiple authentic sources (scholarly review recommended for direct citation)

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. A man keeps on telling the truth until he becomes a truthful person. Falsehood leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Hellfire.'
hadith_entries.source_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094 (Book of Good Manners/Al-Adab, Chapter 69); also Sahih Muslim 2607
hadith_entries.grading: Muttafaqun Alayhi (authenticity agreed upon by both Bukhari and Muslim) — as stated by the source, not independently assessed by this system
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, on-point evidence for sidq (truthfulness) — the single strongest hadith found for this concept, far more direct than hd_002 (which is about good speech generally, not honesty specifically).
hadith_entries.primary_source: sunnah.com (the standard digital hadith reference database) — https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6094

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The strong is not the one who overcomes people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.'
hadith_entries.source_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6114 (Book of Good Manners/Al-Adab); also Sahih Muslim 2609
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, on-point evidence for hilm/self-control — real strength is controlling your anger, not overpowering others.

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The upper hand is better than the lower hand. The upper hand is the one that gives, and the lower hand is the one that takes.'
hadith_entries.narrator: Abdullah ibn Umar / Hakim bin Hizam
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, well-known generosity hadith — giving is better than receiving.
hadith_entries.primary_source: abuaminaelias.com (academic librarian/translator specializing in Quran/Hadith) — cites Sahih al-Bukhari 1429 directly
hadith_entries.confidence: verified — note: not fetched from sunnah.com directly this pass, flagged for a follow-up primary confirmation

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.'
hadith_entries.lesson: The foundational hadith on friendship/brotherhood — want for your friend what you want for yourself.
hadith_entries.confidence: verified — not fetched from sunnah.com directly this pass, flagged for follow-up

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Cleanliness is half of faith.'
hadith_entries.grading: reported as authentic (Sahih Muslim collection, as stated by source)
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, well-known hadith connecting physical cleanliness to faith.

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Every good deed is charity. It is a good deed to meet your brother with a smiling face.'
hadith_entries.grading: Sahih (authentic), as graded by the source
hadith_entries.lesson: Real, child-friendly charity hadith — smiling is itself a form of charity.
hadith_entries.confidence: verified — reverified 2026-08-05, exact reference and grade now confirmed

hadith_entries.text_simplified: A thirsty man found a well, drank, and saw a thirsty dog licking mud. He climbed down, filled his shoe with water using his mouth, and gave the dog to drink. The Prophet said Allah thanked him and forgave him for it. The companions asked, 'Is there a reward for us in serving animals?' He replied, 'Yes, there is a reward for serving any living being.'
hadith_entries.source_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari (widely cited as Book 42, Hadith 11 / hadith 2466 in other numbering systems — exact modern sunnah.com numbering not independently confirmed this pass, flagged)
hadith_entries.grading: reported as Sahih (Sahih al-Bukhari), exact numbering flagged for confirmation
hadith_entries.lesson: Excellent, story-ready hadith directly about kindness/mercy to animals — real, well-attested, and the exact narrative shape (a thirsty animal helped) is naturally child-episode-usable.
hadith_entries.primary_source: abuaminaelias.com (academic translator), cross-confirmed across 5+ independent sources
hadith_entries.confidence: verified — exact modern hadith-numbering not independently reconfirmed against sunnah.com this pass

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The believers in their mutual kindness, compassion, and sympathy are just like one body. When one limb suffers, the whole body responds with sleeplessness and fever.'
hadith_entries.source_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari & Sahih Muslim (as stated by multiple independent sources)
hadith_entries.grading: reported as Muttafaqun Alayhi across sources; exact modern sunnah.com reference number not independently reconfirmed this pass
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, vivid, child-usable image (one body) for community/ummah — we care for each other because we're connected.
hadith_entries.confidence: verified — exact modern hadith-numbering not independently reconfirmed against sunnah.com this pass

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The just will be seated on pulpits of light beside Allah — those who are fair and just in their rulings, with their families, and in whatever they undertook.'
hadith_entries.grading: Sahih (Sahih Muslim), as stated by source
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct hadith on justice — real, well-attested, notes fairness starts within one's own family, very child-relevant.
hadith_entries.primary_source: cross-confirmed across 2 independent pages of the same source + Wikipedia-level general confirmation of Sahih Muslim as a real collection

hadith_entries.text_simplified: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The Compassionate One has mercy on those who are merciful. If you show mercy to those who are on the earth, He Who is in the heaven will show mercy to you.'
hadith_entries.grading: Authentic (as graded by hadeethenc.com, citing Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi, Ahmad)
hadith_entries.lesson: Direct, foundational mercy hadith — real reciprocity teaching, very child-relatable.
